metaTitle: Custom BCG Door Hangers - Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom BCG door hangers in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Durable, UV-coated options for your next campaign.
introHtml: BCG door hangers offer a reliable, cost-effective way to reach your target audience directly. Whether you need standard 7" x 12" knob bags or UV-coated oval paper cards, BCG's consistent quality ensures your message stays put. Perfect for real estate agents, service providers, and local promotions, these hangers accept full-color printing and are easy to hang on any doorknob. Choose BCG for dependable turnaround and sturdy materials that withstand weather.
heroAltText: Custom BCG door hangers with full-color printing and UV coating, ideal for marketing campaigns.
